test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Study the same and identify which of the following statements is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b64be68e9aa721f0892926c71bfffb314632a0146ebd4b02a6521bbce6000227.png]
solution:
In the first and second dice 1 and 2 are common in both dice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0aa66a1f9708f7a18faf723bfac357b7a2f64afeb8e6ce3b71115bb1139c4a99.png] 

So, here 3 is opposite to 5.

In the second and third dice 5 and 2 are common in both dice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac842fae6a8e29477d75668b7d0bc602513a4d48d028390f5bd4a9ef376ba08e.png] 

So, here 1 is opposite to 6.

Opposite face pairs are.

3 → 5

1 → 6

2 → 4

Hence, the correct answer is **"6 is opposite to 1".**
